nodes.title: Workflow Guide

properties.text:
WAN Animate + SAM3 Head Matchmove for Nuke

1. INPUTS
• Input Video: original clip
• Load Face: reference portrait

2. GLOBAL CONTROLS
• Resolution: FaceOnly square size (recommended: 640)
• Crop Margin / Tracking Smoothing / Border Blend: adjust only when needed
• Target Prompt: SAM3 tracking target (example: woman face)

3. OUTPUTS
• Final: full-resolution composite
• Face: stabilized square FaceOnly
• Mask: square black/white SAM3 mask
• Nuke Matchmove: copy the .nk text, then paste in Nuke

REFERENCES
Project
https://github.com/tardis7732/wan-animate-sam3-head-for-nuke

Based on
https://github.com/sonnybox/yt-files/blob/main/COMFY/workflows/Wan%20Animate%20-%20Face%20Only.json

nuke_handoff.description: Live SAM3 tracking drives crop, square B/W mask, Comfy composite and a data-only Nuke CornerPin2D export.
nuke_handoff.nuke_usage: Run once, then use Copy .nk to Clipboard on the final Nuke node and paste it into Nuke. The Face Only MP4 and mask MP4 have identical frame count and raster dimensions.

stabilized_live_sam3.description: Live SAM3 Object 0 motion only, robust fixed crop scale, dynamic Wan temporal padding, per-frame BBOX paste, and an axis-aligned Nuke Transform handoff. Body-mask expansion is excluded from crop scale and vertical centre.

square_controls.notes: FaceOnly resolution is intentionally one Int linked to both Wan width and height. Nuke scale and Y conversion are generated from actual output and plate dimensions.

layout.purpose: Direct-globals copy. One-use Set/Get variables are direct links; behavior is unchanged.
layout.flow: Global/Input - SAM3 - stable crop - Wan - deliverables

border_blending.note: Use small values first; 0.0 retains the previous hard-edge behavior.

temporal_length.trim: decoded frames are trimmed back to N

output_color.reason: Preserves the Comfy RGB tensor exactly; avoids RGB-to-YUV420 color shift.
